name: frogcog
description: Keep a record of every appliance and device in your home, in a folder on your own computer: warranties, registration, upkeep, receipts, manuals, protection plans, possible recalls and a contents list. FrogCog works out the dates. A small program on your computer keeps the records there. Claude asks FrogCog's service about products (a brand, a kind of device, a country), never about you. Only the recall check, if you switch it on, sends anything: brand names, to the official recall list.
